parameters.text:
=You are a product analyst. Return ONLY valid JSON. Quotes must be copied verbatim from the reviews. Never invent text. 
Analyse these {{ $json.analysed }} app reviews.

1. Cluster into AT MOST 5 themes (name, description, review_count, sentiment).
2. Pick the top 3 themes by volume and severity.
3. Extract EXACTLY 3 verbatim user quotes (<30 words each) with review ID and theme. Copy only the review text: do NOT include the [id] or the (N★) rating prefix in the quote.
4. Identify ONE recurring confusion about a fee/charge: fee_name,
   what users misunderstand, 2 evidence quotes with IDs.

Schema:
{"themes":[{"name":"","description":"","review_count":0,"sentiment":""}],
 "top_themes":["","",""],
 "quotes":[{"id":0,"quote":"","theme":""}],
 "fee_issue":{"fee_name":"","misunderstanding":"","evidence":[{"id":0,"quote":""}]}}

REVIEWS:
{{ $json.reviews_block }}

options.systemMessage: You are a product analyst for Groww, an Indian mutual fund investing app. Return ONLY valid JSON. Copy quotes verbatim from the reviews; never invent text.

parameters.text:
=Write an internal weekly product pulse of about 180-210 words (hard maximum 250), from this analysis:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Sections:
1. Top Themes (3 one-line bullets)
2. What Users Are Saying (the 3 quotes, attributed to "Play Store user")
3. Key Observation (2-3 sentences, include the fee confusion)
4. Action Ideas (exactly 3, each starting with a verb)

Concise, internal tone. No fluff.

options.systemMessage: You write concise internal weekly product updates for the Groww product team. Aim for 180-210 words; never exceed 250 words.

parameters.text:
=You write customer support explanations for Groww (Indian mutual fund investing app).
Users in recent reviews are confused about this fee/charge:
Fee: {{ $('Parse and Validate').item.json.fee_issue.fee_name }}
What users misunderstand: {{ $('Parse and Validate').item.json.fee_issue.misunderstanding }}
Evidence: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse and Validate').item.json.fee_issue.evidence) }}

Write a standardized explanation of THIS fee that directly answers the confusion above.
Rules:
- At most 6 bullet points, each one sentence.
- Neutral, facts-only tone. No marketing, no apologies, no advice, no guesses about numbers you are not sure of.
- Choose the 2 most relevant source links ONLY from this list (copy exactly):
  https://www.amfiindia.com/investor/knowledge-center-info?zoneName=expenseRatio  (expense ratio / TER)
  https://www.amfiindia.com/ter-of-mf-schemes  (scheme-wise TER, direct vs regular)
  https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/faqfiles/sep-2024/1727242783639.pdf  (SEBI mutual fund FAQ: exit load, loads, charges)
  https://groww.in/pricing  (Groww charges: brokerage, DP, stamp duty, GST, other charges)

Return ONLY valid JSON: {"fee_name":"","bullets":[""],"source_links":["",""]}

options.systemMessage: You write neutral, facts-only customer support explanations about investment fees and charges in India. Return only valid JSON.
